Scripted Test Case-এ সব bug ধরা পড়ে না। কিছু bug শুধু তখনই ধরা পড়ে যখন একজন curious, experienced tester software-কে "মানুষের মতো" use করে — কোনো fixed script ছাড়া, কিন্তু random click-ও নয়।

Exploratory Testing (ET) অনেক junior QA-র কাছে confusing — "test case না লিখে test?" মনে হয় unprofessional। আসলে ET industry-standard technique, ISTQB-তেও recognize করা। এই post-এ ET কী, কখন use করবেন, session কীভাবে run করবেন — সব step by step, সহজ ভাষায় explain করা হয়েছে।

---

Exploratory Testing কী? — সহজ সংজ্ঞা

Cem Kaner-এর famous definition অনুযায়ী:

"Exploratory Testing হলো simultaneous learning, test design, এবং test execution — একই সময়ে চলে।"

মানে হলো:

  • আপনি software use করছেন
  • use করতে করতে নতুন idea পাচ্ছেন — "এটা try করলে কী হয়?"
  • সেই idea immediately test করেন
  • যা learn করলেন তা দিয়ে পরের test design করেন

ET ≠ Random Testing:

Random click করা exploratory testing নয় — সেটা ad-hoc testing (unstructured, no goal)। ET-এ goal, time limit, notes, এবং skilled thinking থাকে। Informed, intelligent testing।

---

Scripted vs Exploratory — পার্থক্য বুঝুন

বিষয় Scripted Testing Exploratory Testing
Planআগে থেকে লেখা test caseচলতে চলতে design হয়
CoveragePlanned, boundedOpen-ended, adaptive
Bug typeKnown scenariosUnknown, unexpected
RepeatabilityEasy — same stepsHard — depends on tester skill
Best forRegression, complianceNew feature, UX, edge cases

Important: ET scripted testing-এর প্রতিযোগী নয় — complement। Best QA teams দুটোই করে। Scripted = "known requirements met?" Exploratory = "unknown bugs hidden?"

---

Session-Based Exploratory Testing (SBET)

ET-কে structure দেওয়ার সবচেয়ে popular method — James Bach এবং Jon Bach promote করেছেন। প্রতিটি session-এ 4টি element:

1. Charter (মিশন)

এই session-এ কী explore করবেন — one sentence mission। Vague নয়, focused।

Good charter: "Explore payment checkout flow focusing on discount code and edge case amounts."

Bad charter: "Test the app." (too broad, no focus)

2. Time Box (সময় সীমা)

Typically 60–90 minutes per session। Timer set করুন — time pressure creative thinking boost করে, endless wandering prevent করে।

3. Notes (নোট নিন)

Testing করতে করতে লিখুন:

  • কী test করলেন
  • কী observe করলেন
  • কোন bug suspect
  • আর কী explore করা বাকি

4. Debrief (আলোচনা)

Session শেষে team lead বা developer-এর সাথে 15 minute review — findings share, priority decide, next session plan।

---

Real Session Example — File Upload Feature

Charter: "Explore file upload feature focusing on large files, unusual formats, and cancel behavior."

Time Box: 90 minutes

Notes during session:

  • 100MB file upload — browser freeze 30 sec, no progress indicator (UX issue)
  • .exe file rename to .jpg — upload accepted (critical security bug)
  • Filename 200+ characters — UI layout break (UI bug)
  • Upload cancel mid-way — partial file server-এ save (data integrity bug)
  • Bengali filename "ছবি.jpg" — upload success, display correct (pass)

Session result: 4 issues found — 2 critical (security + partial save), 1 major (UX), 1 minor (layout)। Scripted test case-এ শুধু "valid JPG upload" থাকলে 3টা bug miss হতো।

---

Exploratory Testing Techniques

Heuristic Testing — SFDIPOT

James Bach-এর mnemonic — explore করার সময় এই areas mind-এ রাখুন:

  • Structure — UI layout, navigation, data structure
  • Function — feature কাজ করছে কিনা
  • Data — input validation, boundary, special chars
  • Interface — API, third-party integration
  • Platform — browser, mobile, OS difference
  • Operations — install, upgrade, backup, error recovery
  • Time — performance over time, expiry, timeout

Tours — Guided Exploration

Michael Kelly-এর concept — specific "tour" follow করুন:

  • Supermodel Tour: শুধু UI look — alignment, color, spacing
  • Landmark Tour: Key features hit — login, checkout, profile
  • Bad Neighborhood Tour: Error-prone areas — old code, rarely changed modules
  • All-Nighter Tour: Long session — memory leak, session timeout

Persona-Based Testing

Different user role হিসেবে think করুন:

  • Impatient user — rapid click, double submit
  • Confused user — wrong order, back button abuse
  • Malicious user — injection, bypass attempt
  • Power user — keyboard shortcuts, bulk actions
---

Charter লেখার Template — 10টি Ready Example

নিজের project-এ adapt করুন:

  1. "Explore login flow focusing on error messages and account lockout behavior."
  2. "Explore registration with invalid, duplicate, and special character inputs."
  3. "Explore payment checkout with discount codes, partial amounts, and timeout."
  4. "Explore search feature with empty query, special chars, and no results."
  5. "Explore pagination — last page, page beyond total, sort change mid-navigation."
  6. "Explore file upload — large file, wrong format, cancel mid-upload."
  7. "Explore admin panel — unauthorized access attempt, role permission boundaries."
  8. "Explore mobile responsive layout — small screen, landscape, touch targets."
  9. "Explore session behavior — logout, back button, expired session, multi-tab."
  10. "Explore report export — PDF download, empty data, large dataset timeout."
---

কখন Exploratory Testing সবচেয়ে কার্যকর?

  • New feature release — scripted case এখনো কম, ET দিয়ে early bug find
  • Requirements unclear — Agile sprint, story incomplete acceptance criteria
  • Complex user flows — e-commerce checkout, multi-step wizard
  • Usability & UX — confusing flow, bad error message — scripted case catch করে না
  • Time-pressed release — regression limited, ET দিয়ে critical area quick scan
  • After automation — automated tests pass, ET দিয়ে "automation gap" fill

কখন ET alone যথেষ্ট নয়

  • Compliance/regulated industry — audit trail দরকার, scripted + documented mandatory
  • Full regression every release — ET repeatability কম
  • Junior tester without guidance — structure ছাড়া ineffective
---

Findings Document করুন — Session Report Template

ET unstructured মনে হলেও documentation important — bug report এবং knowledge share-এর জন্য:

  • Session ID & Date: ET-2026-07-11-01
  • Tester: Name
  • Charter: One-line mission
  • Duration: 90 min
  • Environment: Staging, Chrome 120, Windows 11
  • Areas Covered: Bullet list
  • Bugs Found: ID, severity, brief description
  • Questions/Risks: Unclear behavior, need dev clarification
  • Next Session Suggestion: Unexplored areas
---

Common Mistakes — এড়িয়ে চলুন

  • No charter — aimless clicking, time waste
  • No time box — 4 hour session, fatigue, diminishing returns
  • No notes — bug reproduce steps ভুলে যাওয়া
  • ET = no documentation — session report skip করা
  • Only ET, no scripted — regression gap, known requirement miss
  • Only scripted, no ET — unknown bug escape to production
---

Agile Sprint-এ ET কীভাবে Fit করে

Typical sprint ET integration:

  1. Sprint planning: New story-র জন্য 1–2 ET charter assign
  2. During development: Feature branch ready → 60 min ET session
  3. Before demo: Quick ET on integrated build — smoke + explore
  4. Sprint retrospective: ET findings review — pattern identify (same area repeated bugs?)

ET effort: sprint capacity-এর 10–20% reasonable — pure ET team নয়, balanced approach।

---

Skill Development — Better Explorer হতে

  • Curiosity cultivate করুন — "what if I..." habit
  • Domain knowledge — banking app test করলে payment flow বুঝুন
  • Technical awareness — DevTools, API basics — deeper bug find
  • Pair exploratory — senior + junior same session, learning accelerate
  • Bug pattern study — past bugs review, same area re-explore

Pro Tip:

প্রতি new feature release-এ minimum 1 ET session (90 min) charter সহ run করুন। Findings Jira/Azure DevOps-এ log করুন tag: exploratory। 3 sprint পর review করুন — ET কত bug catch করেছে vs scripted regression। Data দিয়ে ET value prove করুন management-এ।

---

পরিশেষে

Exploratory Testing একটি skill — random clicking নয়। Charter, time box, notes, debrief — structure দিয়ে ET professional এবং measurable।

মনে রাখুন:

  1. ET scripted testing replace করে না — complement করে
  2. Session-Based approach ET-কে repeatable এবং reportable করে
  3. New feature, unclear requirements, UX issues — ET সবচেয়ে effective
  4. Good charter + SFDIPOT heuristic = better bug discovery

আজ থেকেই পরের new feature-এ একটি 90-minute ET session plan করুন — charter লিখুন, timer set করুন, notes নিন। Experience দিয়ে ET skill grow হয়।

Tags: #ExploratoryTesting #SessionBased #TestCharter #SFDIPOT #ManualTesting #BugHunting #AgileTesting #QA #SQA
